player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Mastermind.
You need to find the code that is {code_length} digits long, each digit from 1 to {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
In your response, you can submit your guess in the following format: '[2 1 4 5]'.
After each guess, you will receive feedback in the form of black and white pegs.
A black peg indicates a correct digit in the correct position, while a white peg indicates a correct digit in the wrong position.
You have {max_turns} turns to guess the code.
player_prompt.with_repeats: Pɩpɩzɩɣ nɛ pɩla se kɩɖaɣnɩ labʋ mbʋ ɖɔɖɔ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ŋtaamaɣzɩ se ŋpɩzɩɣ nɛ ŋkpaɣ tɔm ndʋ tɩ-taa lɛ, ŋlɛɣzɩɣ hɔɔlʋʋ nakʋyʋ.
invalid_move.not_integers: Pɩwɛɛ se tɔm ndʋ tɩ-tɩŋa payɩ pamawa yɔ, tiɖiɣni wɛʋ.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Pɩwɛɛ se pamaɣzɩ nɛ pana ɖɔɖɔ {code_length}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Pɩwɛɛ se nimero waa tɩŋa ɩwɛ 1 nɛ {num_numbers} pɛ-hɛkʋ taa.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: Pahaɣ nʋmɔʋ se ɛyʋ ɛtasɩ maʋ takayaɣ nakɛyɛ.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Ŋtɛm ɖʋʋ {guess}. Tɩŋnɩ lɛɛɖɛ yɔɔ nɛ ŋmaɣzɩna-ɖɩ.

game_action.feedback: Submitted [{guess}]. Feedback: {black_pegs} black peg(s), {white_pegs} white peg(s).

outcome.win: You have cracked the code, solving {black_pegs} out of {code_length} pegs correctly
outcome.turn_limit: Turn limit reached. You guessed {percent} percent of the numbers correctly.
